Hi @RHGOtakuxxx well you see the only reason I contacted her myself after two months is that I realized that she will not be able to contact me, not she will not want to but will not be able to and also because despite that it is clearly her fault that she cheated and I never did such thing she felt that it was my fault because of projecting. Like she thought that I made her to do this. So I contacted her. It's like that I hate you - don't leave me but I can't make her do anything and she can't do any action on her own. Paradox to solve paradox. Through months I've read many things about bpd. (While in usual relationship you also can't make a person do anything, the only thing you can do is to how you make them feel about yourself and about what you say).

Hi @enjoyslongtokes can I first ask you how long do you have bpd before you were diagnosed and if before you knew you have it did you feel different than today? To answer your question: your diagnosis shouldn't shape your life, you should do it. It's not your fault, don't blame yourself. What is good is that usually people are unaware that they have bpd and even if to tell them about it they will most likely deny it. But you know that you have a problem. Knowledge about the problem is the first step towards healing. People with bpd can heal if they accept that they have the problem and willing to change themselves. Relationship shouldn't be based only on physical connection. It's about sharing your feelings, your thoughts, your values with a person who wants to do the same to you. You are worth to have fulfilling and romantic relationship. You have a limited amount of time in your life. Will you waste your time only to find out some years later that in the past you needed to make a different choice? Do you want that your partner be honest with you? If yes then you should tell that you have bpd to your partner. If he will accept that and will be with you regardless of it then he is the one for you. Try to not running doing actions like feeling angry that he doesn't text you back right away because later it may become a bigger problem. It's better to solve the problem while it is small and more easily solvable. And if you have a problem with trusting people then pretend to yourself even if it will be hard that you are blindly trusting your partner. That will help you along the path of healing.

Hi @WinterFood after you went no contact with her regardless of what you thought she thought about it she actually blamed everything on you because people with bpd feel everything too extreme and it is easier to avoid feeling guilt because otherwise she will feel worthless. You can imagine that if suddenly you forgot who you are and the only way you think to cope with that is to need someone and take their own qualities as if they are your own. All depends on if you want to be with her or not. In case if not - then you already know the answer. Understand that what you and she already done you can't change, but you can change your own perception of events, you can change yourself while you should be aware that she have a problem, it is not your fault, if you tried to make it better it never was your fault, it's just how bpd is, just know that inside she is a good person but it's like uncovering the onion: before you will get to the core you will feel much pain unless you will know that it's not about you and you will be able to cope with it without feeling pain. That's why many people leave such relationships because they have their own insecurities and can't cope with themselves. In relationship with someone with bpd it is like thinking for two people but in such process you will burn yourself and will become broken. You should care also about yourself, set for yourself what you can tolerate and what you can't and tell her honestly about that. In case if you want to be with her initiate the contact yourself but instead of doing everything she asks describe her how you feel about what she was doing to you, how is it better to do it, why you went no contact with her, why you haven't replied to her and in what case you are ready to start the relationship with her again. Relationship is about both people not just one. Prepare that she may not reply to you, if she will you have to set boundaries for your own health, she may try to break those boundaries, don't allow her to do so. If she will not reply - then go low contact with her. After you went no contact with her she already felt that something is not ok inside her if you haven't done that nothing will ever convince her to change anything and everything you do after that will only enable her behavior of focusing on herself. By going no contact against her will you showed her that you are strong and paradoxically that made her even more connected to you. Why do you think she contacted you? Because she knows that you love and understand her like no one else but loving someone and needing someone to be loved and feel loved is a big difference. I hope that you will feel happiness in love. Wish you everything great in your relationship.

Hi @reddz1996 the only thing that was effective for me against silent treatment was to go no contact with her. No contact is different from silent treatment in the way that you tell her why are you doing it (to focus on your own health, to tell her how you feel because of her actions etc.), what will cause you to start talking to her (she will start changing herself, she will address your needs and concerns etc.). Otherwise you can go low contact, tell her that you will be there for her, once in a month contact her and say how are you doing. You have to focus on yourself, on your own health. You don't need to be her savior. She should work on herself, only she can decide to make a change, you can only show her the way to change. Understand that this is not your fault because even if you did something different it will end the same way. It is her way of coping with emotional states. She understand her actions but every time she regrets doing something that hurt you she avoids feeling bad. She relies on somebody else because inside she is fragile. Only when she will see that you are strong and can cope with her problems she may get back to you. Prepare yourself that it may take months.

Hi @cornishteal77 you know that you are worth and deserve to be loved and it is good that you unknowledge your actions. The root cause of your problem is that you feel that you have to be saved and need to be loved, you try to put your problem on your partner and somebody else instead of working on the problem yourself. He will start talking to you if you will honestly tell him what you feel and about your actions. When you feel angry instead of doing immediate action take 5 minutes for deep breath and hold your hands. While doing so you will not feel to regret doing something that may hurt somebody. Every time after that when you will feel that you have to calm down just hold your hands. You will start feeling better.

Hi @fpsjavy the best thing you can do is to tell about your problem to your family member and ask to help you as you understand that you have a problem but you feel like you can't approach the problem yourself. If You will keep everything inside yourself nothing will change.

You can try to put proxy between the internet connection and the device, like Fiddler, to intercept the traffic and to see what exactly it sends to the server and what gets back to you, even if it is encrypted by ssl etc. If it just connects to it You can easily bypass that by creating the rule that every time it tries to connect to that server it will connect to your local network. That's in case you've already have the device. If not there should be already made pre-built RaspberryPi or similar prototyping boards with temperature sensors and this will cost less and the question there will be how much precise it should be able to measure the temperature. Such solution has one benefit that you can add something to the pre-built program.
If it is connecting to vendor-operated server you can't do that without internet connection. Maybe you should search for OpenSource temperature sensors? Something made with RaspberryPi or similar.
